_comment: Population cells for the Present chapter's MapLibre layer. NOT terrain — terrain stays null in the scene document. People per cell at three resolutions, each cut for its own zooms, from the same GHS-POP tiles as the region fields, within the world disc. The layer itself is public/cells/wat-ket.cells.pmtiles; this records what is in it.

properties.d: great-circle km from the origin to the cell centre
properties.h: cube-root density fraction, 0-1, same scale — the height
properties.t: log10 ramp position of density, 0-1, on one scale for every level — the colour

source.attribution: European Commission JRC, Global Human Settlement Layer
